title: Compatible finite quotient grid from adic formal smoothness
statement: Let R,S,A be commutative rings with R-algebra structures on S and A [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], and n an ideal of S such that S is formally smooth over R for the n-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Let I,J be ideals of A and g:S -> A/J an R-algebra map satisfying g(n^r) contained in the image of I for some r≥1. There exist R-algebra maps F_{a,b}:S -> A/(J^a+I^b) for every a,b≥0, compatible with every quotient transition when a≤a′,b≤b′, such that F_{1,b} is g followed by A/J -> A/(J+I^b). No completeness or closedness is assumed, nor any containment of a power of J in I.

source.place: Proof of Lemma Tag 07NJ (lemma-lift-continuous), quotient grid and induction paragraphs; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07NJ

proof.text: For b ≥ 1 reduce g to A/(J+I^b). The map kills n^(r*b): the image of n^r lies in the image of I and taking bth ideal powers puts it in the image of I^b, which is zero. For b=0 the quotient is the zero ring. These first-row maps are compatible by functoriality of quotient maps.

The square-zero lifting property can be applied in the independent universe of A. Given a square-zero problem in D, choose a representative of g(s) for each s in S. The R-subalgebra B generated by these representatives has a carrier no larger than max(|R|,|S|,aleph_0), hence has a model in Type(max u v). Let K be the intersection of B with the square-zero ideal of D. The image of B in D/J contains g(S), so g factors through B/K; transport to the small model, apply formal smoothness, and compose the lift with B -> D. The square-zero and power-annihilation properties restrict along the inclusions.

Starting from the first-row map at (1,1), construct the bottom row by successive lifts along A/(J^(a+1)+I) -> A/(J^a+I). Its kernel is the image of J^a and has square zero since 2a ≥ a+1 for a≥1. If a map kills n^k, every square-zero lift kills n^(2k). Thus each subsequent lifting problem satisfies the positive-power condition.

For a,b≥1 set K=J^(a+1)+I^b, L=J^a+I^(b+1), D=J^(a+1)+I^(b+1). The map A/D -> A/K ×_{A/(K+L)} A/L is surjective: compatible representatives x,y satisfy x-y=k+l, and x-k=y+l represents a preimage. Its kernel (K intersection L)/D is contained in the image of I^b, whose square is zero since 2b≥b+1. Here K+L=J^a+I^b.

Induct on a+b to construct all positive grid entries. Given compatible entries (a+1,b) and (a,b+1), their pair is an algebra map to the fibre product killing a common positive power of n, using the larger of their two annihilation exponents. Lift through the square-zero surjection of the preceding step. The lifting equation gives both adjacent compatibilities. The first row and bottom row supply the boundary conditions. Iterating adjacent transitions yields the stated compatibility for arbitrary a≤a′ and b≤b′.
When a=0 or b=0 the quotient is zero because J^0=I^0=A. Extend the family by its unique algebra maps at these entries. Their transition and first-row compatibilities follow from uniqueness.

theorem FormallySmoothAdic.exists_quotient_grid
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A]
    (n : Ideal S) (hS : FormallySmoothAdic R S n) (I J : Ideal A)
    (g : S →ₐ[R] A ⧸ J) (r : ℕ) (hr : 1 ≤ r)
    (hg : ∀ x ∈ n ^ r, g x ∈ I.map (Ideal.Quotient.mk J)) :
    ∃ F : (a b : ℕ) → S →ₐ[R] A ⧸ (J ^ a ⊔ I ^ b),
      (∀ (a b a' b' : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ a') (hb : b ≤ b'),
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (sup_le_sup
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right ha) (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hb))).comp
            (F a' b') = F a b) ∧
      ∀ b : ℕ,
        (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (show J ^ 1 ⊔ I ^ b ≤ J ⊔ I ^ b by simp)).comp
          (F 1 b) = (Ideal.Quotient.factorₐ R (le_sup_left : J ≤ J ⊔ I ^ b)).comp
            g
